caption: The image shows a drawing of a beige or light tan ceramic jar with two small handles near the top and a rounded lip opening. The jar features a blue decorative design on the body, which depicts two stylized human figures facing each other. The figure on the left has what appears to be dots on its body and is standing on a wavy line, with both arms raised and bent at the elbows. The figure on the right is dressed in a long garment and also has one arm raised. There are two small blue diamond-like shapes above the figures. The jar has the inscription “COWDEN & WILCOX” impressed near the top between the handles. The drawing is rendered on a plain, light background, and the artist’s signature, "G. C. Locheridge," is visible at the lower right corner.
title: Stoneware Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
